pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal and sub-rectangular dark regions exhibiting soft pixel gradients at the edges. Patch size is largest on the upper shoulder/back and decreases in spatial area moving toward the lower flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Highly connected negative-space grid of light cream pathways. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radial. Pathway thickness is relatively consistent across the upper dorsal regions, forming a continuous topological web.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Mane presents a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated 1D contour along the neck. The silhouette consists of short, vertical bristly hair structures with minimal variation in height.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant pixel occlusion caused by the neck of a second individual in the mid-ground, and extensive foreground obstruction from dry, thorny vegetation masking the lower third of the subject.
